ns2:course.label: Corporate & Commercial Law
ns2:course.description: Advanced discussion of corporate and commercial law, including topics tested on the CPA exam: agency, contracts, debtor-creditor relationships, governmental regulation of business and business organizations. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BS:Accountancy -UIUC, BS:Finance -UIUC, BS: Marketing - UIUC, BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech -UIUC, BS: Supply Chain Mgmt -UIUC, BS: Business Process Mgt -UIUC, BS: Management -UIUC, BS:Information Systems -UIUC, BS:Operations Management -UIUC, BS: Business Multi Majors-UIUC, MAS:Accountancy -UIUC, MS: Accy - Cost Rec -UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
